main.title: Meet Jo Starkie
main.name: Jo Starkie
main.description: I'm a Software Engineer II at Microsoft, building customer-facing features, APIs and SDKs for Dynamics 365 Contact Center
main.bio: I'm a Software Engineer II at Microsoft working on Dynamics 365 Contact Center, with experience across TypeScript, C#, Azure, APIs and SDK development. Previously a Cloud Solution Architect, I bring both engineering and customer-facing experience to product development. I build customer-facing features and APIs, contribute to shared components, and investigate production issues using telemetry and debugging. I actively mentor early-career Cloud Solution Architects and aspiring Software Engineers, co-founded UnlockHerTech (shortlisted for the WIT Summit Awards 2023), and contribute to Women & Allies, Code Club, career mentoring and STEM outreach. My personality type is INFJ-T (if you're interested)!
main.contactmessage: Feel free to reach out via any of my social medias below, I'll be more than happy to chat and help where I can. I'd love to hear from you.

resume.skillmessage: My development experience spans C#, TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Node.js, SQL, PowerShell and Bicep. I work with Azure, Dynamics 365, Azure Data Factory, Azure Functions, AKS, Microsoft Fabric, Dataverse, Power Platform and Microsoft Purview. My engineering focus includes API and SDK development, automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, observability and event-driven systems, using Azure DevOps, Git, GitHub, TypeSpec/OpenAPI and VS Code. Selected skills are highlighted below; see my GitHub for examples of my work.

education.degree: BSc (Hons) Computer Science (Artificial Intelligence) with Professional Practice
education.description: First Class Honours. Received the Computer Science Department Award for the highest GPA in the cohort and the Undergraduate Academic Excellence Scholarship for four years. Certifications earned: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (DA-100), Azure Data Fundamentals (DP-900), Azure AI Fundamentals (AI-900), and GitHub Foundations.

work.title: Software Engineer II
work.description: Dynamics 365 Contact Center | Voice Channel & Headless CSR SDK. • Develop customer-facing features across voice, messaging and the Headless Customer Service Representative SDK, working primarily with TypeScript and Microsoft's Contact Center platform. • Contribute to the CSR TypeScript SDK, enabling enterprise customers to build their own representative experiences; delivered APIs and capabilities covering conversations, presence, disposition codes, messaging and administration. • Owned end-to-end delivery of Adaptive Card and rich-message support, enabling applications to retrieve and send rich content and handle customer responses; designed conversation-state handling and demonstrated the completed feature to the engineering team. • Improved public API design and consistency through pagination, API types and usage patterns, validating changes against the sample application from a consumer's perspective. • Redesigned dialpad validation across the main and embedded Contact Center experiences, replacing duplicated validation with a shared implementation for agents and supervisors with voice access; delivered and monitored the change behind a feature flag for controlled rollout. • Own customer and production investigations across calling, recording, transcription, workstreams and third-party integrations, using telemetry, code tracing and reproduction environments to identify defects and coordinate fixes. • Add automated test coverage, improve SDK tooling and sample applications, review team changes, and maintain onboarding and technical documentation.

work.title: Software Engineer
work.description: Dynamics 365 | Retail & Data Platforms. • Developed features and services across Dynamics 365 and Microsoft's retail products using C#, Azure, React/TypeScript and data services. • Helped take the ISV Data Connector for Smart Store Analytics from private preview to general availability, working with Azure Data Factory on pipelines, validation, deployment and integration issues alongside the ADF product team. • Built and improved backend retail data services, including event handling to prevent duplicate processing; refactored C# services and expanded automated test coverage. • Developed APIs and deployment tooling for partner integrations, including OpenAPI/TypeSpec definitions, automated security checks and configuration of services running in Azure Kubernetes Service. • Prototyped integrations between Dynamics 365 Commerce and AI-powered shopping experiences, indexing retail product data for a personalised shopping agent and importing Microsoft 365 content into retail catalogue experiences. • Worked in a two-person engineering team to build and demonstrate a Retail Data Manager connector within six weeks for an NRF industry event, working through data-ingestion issues with the relevant product teams ahead of the demonstration. • Contributed localisation, telemetry, customer lookup, routing and voice improvements, alongside code reviews, onboarding, documentation and project handover.

work.title: Cloud Solution Architect
work.description: Azure | Data, Analytics & AI. • Worked with customers to design Azure data and analytics solutions, focusing on data warehousing and Microsoft Purview; helped customers adopt Purview and shared feedback with product engineering teams. • Built PowerShell and Bicep tools, examples and hands-on labs to make Purview easier to deploy and learn. The PowerShell accelerator reached 304 unique clones and 92 recorded script executions within two weeks of release. • Created and delivered training on Azure Databricks, Git and CI/CD to around 80 Cloud Solution Architects, and helped run Power BI workshops attended by 23 people.

work.title: IT Consultant
work.description: • Developed and maintained the virtual platform that directly resulted in new admission leads.• Modified the Content Management System (CMS) provided structure to manage the changing requirements of the website, using HTML and CSS languages.• Producing marketing materials using Photoshop and Microsoft Publisher software to raise awareness of the company with its clients.• Adhering to deadlines on the projects being worked on enabling me to advance my time management skills.• Offering practical solutions and ideas in order to meet the company's requirements for the website and overall business needs.• Trusted member of staff – worked remotely from home further developing my time management, self-motivation and discipline skills.

work.title: Commercial IT Business Integrator
work.description: • Used the JavaScript frameworks ReactJS & NodeJS to develop and successfully deliver the global Elanco Students website, that was instrumental in attracting future talent to the student programme.• Designed and implemented an interface between a Salesforce system and Oracle database, resulting in large savings for the affiliate's reporting activities and a new foundation for further systems to be built on.• Exercised my skills in Microsoft Flow, PowerApps and SharePoint platforms to build and automate a tracker tool for the UK & Ireland Affiliate.• Proactively improved the performance of the portal by increasing the Google Lighthouse and SEO Audits with Progressive Web Application functionality and further accessibility considerations.• Increased team productivity by facilitating the delivery of projects as a Scrum Master in Agile Scrum methodology within my development teams.• Successfully managed my project teams using my gained experience with the Atlassian JIRA DevOps tool and Confluence Collaboration software.
